_comment: Hand and review-pass corrections for tools/generate_deck_korean.py. _drop removes a word; _add forces one in; other keys override gloss/reading/pos/posName for that word.

_drop_reasons.에다: analyser fragment (에 + 다); the rare verb is not a useful learner word
_drop_reasons.아냐: contraction of conjugated 아니야 (from 아니다), not a separate lexical item
_drop_reasons.고다: rare verb, rank inflated by analyser artifacts
_drop_reasons.일다: obscure verb; gloss is garbled and rank likely inflated by analyser artifacts
_drop_reasons.도다: imperative-only archaic/analyser fragment (of 주다), not a usable headword
_drop_reasons.까지다: rare/obscure verb, likely analyser artifact (까지 + 이다)
_drop_reasons.했다: inflected past form of 하다, not a dictionary headword
_drop_reasons.보이: rare loanword, occurs mainly in compounds
_drop_reasons.제다: analyser fragment (Jeddah), not a Korean verb
_drop_reasons.는데다: analyser fragment (ending -는데 + 다), not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.들: plural suffix / rare noun sense; sentences only use 그들 (they), not this word
_drop_reasons.레이: foreign word (lei) / name; not a useful Korean vocabulary item
_drop_reasons.그린: analyser fragment (adnominal of 그리다 'painted') / English loanword 'green' of marginal use
_drop_reasons.해서: analyser fragment: contracted 해서 (from 하다, 'and so/because'); gloss 'print' is an obscure Sino-Korean word
_drop_reasons.해요: conjugated form of 하다 (duplicate of 하다)
_drop_reasons.미치: stem fragment of 미치다, not a word on its own
_drop_reasons.됐다: conjugated form of 되다 (duplicate of 되다)
_drop_reasons.사람들: plural inflection (사람 + 들); duplicate of 사람
_drop_reasons.다운: bound suffix (-다운, as in 학생다운), not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.메이: dialect form (Hwanghae) / not a standard word
_drop_reasons.호다: obscure sewing term, gloss unreliable; not a useful learner word
_drop_reasons.루크: name/chess-piece loanword, not a useful learner word
_drop_reasons.도록: mostly an analyser fragment of the ending -도록 (so that, until); noun sense (catalogue) is rare
_drop_reasons.대해: analyser fragment of 대하다 (as in ~에 대해, 'about'); noun senses are rare
_drop_reasons.로드: ambiguous loanword fragment (rod/road/load/lord); not used as a standalone word
_drop_reasons.왔다: inflected form (past tense) of 오다; duplicate of 오다
_drop_reasons.인데: ending/copula fragment (이다 + ㄴ데), not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.보일: obscure fabric loanword (voile), not useful for learners
_drop_reasons.만나: religious term 'manna' / analyser fragment of 만나다 stem; not a useful word
_drop_reasons.오래다: analyser fragment; learners need 오래 (adv) and 오래되다
_drop_reasons.이러: fragment/horse-driving interjection, not a useful word
_drop_reasons.해도: rare nautical term; analyser likely confuses with 하다+도
_drop_reasons.마: obscure sense/fragment, not a useful word
_drop_reasons.둘다: analyser artefact: spacing variant of the phrase 둘 다 (two words), not a single lexical item
_drop_reasons.타이: old-style name for Thailand; standard word is 태국 (duplicate); modern 타이 mostly means 'tie'
_drop_reasons.코다: not a real word; analyser fragment
_drop_reasons.답다: bound suffix (-답다 'like, worthy of'), not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.제니: personal name (Jenny); gloss 'genie' is also wrong
_drop_reasons.구나: sentence-final ending (-구나), not a word; gloss is wrong
_drop_reasons.다양: root of 다양하다 (be diverse), not used as a standalone word
_drop_reasons.갈: fragment/obscure homonyms; not a useful standalone word
_drop_reasons.누리: analyser fragment of 누리다 / mostly names; rare literary word
_drop_reasons.바른: inflected form of 바르다, not a headword
_drop_reasons.꺼다: not a real word (nonstandard form of 끄다) with a garbage gloss
_drop_reasons.일어나: inflected fragment of 일어나다 (duplicate of that verb), not a noun
_drop_reasons.어도: obscure term (fishway); also coincides with the ending -어도
_drop_reasons.랜드: bound loanword fragment (-land) / currency rand; not a useful standalone word
_drop_reasons.라: single syllable (musical note 'la'), not a useful vocabulary item
_drop_reasons.매기: obscure financial term / analyser fragment of 매기다
_drop_reasons.그게: contraction of 그것+이/가 (그것이), not a separate word
_drop_reasons.와서: inflected form of 오다 (와서 = come and)
_drop_reasons.밤새다: non-standard; the standard forms are 밤을 새우다 / 밤새우다
_drop_reasons.애비: non-standard/dialect variant of 아비/아버지; obscure sense
_drop_reasons.더니: verbal connective ending (-더니), not a word
_drop_reasons.열린: inflected (participle) form of 열리다/열다, not a dictionary headword
_drop_reasons.레다: analyser fragment, not a Korean word
_drop_reasons.친구들: plural form of 친구 (friend); gloss also wrong
_drop_reasons.멋진: inflected (adnominal) form of 멋지다, not a dictionary headword
_drop_reasons.쿠다: analyser fragment (contraction of -라고 하다), not a word
_drop_reasons.캐롤: proper name / spelling variant of 캐럴 (carol)
_drop_reasons.남산: proper noun (name of a mountain in Seoul)
_drop_reasons.아도: analyser fragment, not a real standard word; gloss is nonsense
_drop_reasons.차지다: rare/odd form (likely analyser fragment of 차지하다); gloss is wrong
_drop_reasons.존: ambiguous transliteration (mostly the name John); card's sense 'zone' is rare and sentences use the name
_drop_reasons.비치: fragment (from 비치하다 etc.); gloss is meaningless
_drop_reasons.미미: obscure noun; usually a name or fragment of 미미하다
_drop_reasons.화난: inflected participle of 화나다, not a dictionary form
_drop_reasons.아름다운: inflected form of 아름답다, not a dictionary form
_drop_reasons.고자: obscure/archaic or insulting term (eunuch); gloss 'mischief' is wrong
_drop_reasons.민주: bound root; the word is 민주주의 (democracy) or 민주적
_drop_reasons.합리: bound root; the usable words are 합리적 and 합리화
_drop_reasons.석다: non-standard/analyser artifact, not a standard word (cf. 섞다, 썩다, 녹다)
_drop_reasons.빠다: non-standard variant of 버터 (butter), which is also in the deck
_drop_reasons.당당: stem of 당당하다 (to be confident/dignified); gloss garbled, not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.맞이: mostly a suffix in compounds (새해맞이); the real word is 맞이하다
_drop_reasons.마마: historical royal honorific, rare in modern usage
_drop_reasons.솔다: rare/dialectal verb with unreliable gloss, likely analyser artifact
_drop_reasons.나쁜: inflected (adnominal) form of 나쁘다 'to be bad'; gloss wrong
_drop_reasons.간단: stem of 간단하다 'to be simple'; gloss describes an unrelated rare word
_drop_reasons.쓰리: English loan 'three' used only in compounds; not a standalone numeral (learners use 삼/셋)
_drop_reasons.해라: inflected imperative form of 하다, not a separate word
_drop_reasons.어지다: analyser fragment of the auxiliary -아/어지다, not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.가리: obscure word (bamboo cage/coop), mostly occurs in compounds
_drop_reasons.이하다: analyser fragment of 이하 'below/under'; obscure sense
_drop_reasons.쩔다: slang/non-standard stressed form of 절다; current gloss misleading
_drop_reasons.가까운: inflected adnominal form of 가깝다 (analyser fragment)
_drop_reasons.익숙: bound root of 익숙하다, not used alone
_drop_reasons.준: hanja eumhun/analyser fragment (past determiner form of 주다), not a word
_drop_reasons.예쁜: inflected (adnominal) form of 예쁘다 'to be pretty', not a dictionary headword
_drop_reasons.전해: analyser fragment (inflected 전하다 'transmit'); the rare noun 'electrolysis' is not a learner word
_drop_reasons.강하: rare noun (descent); likely fragment of 강하다 'to be strong'
_drop_reasons.에어: bound combining form only (에어컨, 에어백); gloss 'ayr' is wrong
_drop_reasons.리아: foreign fragment/name; not a usable word
_drop_reasons.후안: bound Sino-Korean element (only in 후안무치) / also a transliterated name (Juan); not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.하: bound noun/suffix (-하 'under'), not a standalone word; interjection tag is wrong
_drop_reasons.계시: rare religious term; likely an analyser fragment of honorific 계시다
_drop_reasons.섹시: sexual connotation; also not a dictionary noun (섹시하다 is the real form)
_drop_reasons.아이들: plural form of 아이 (a higher-ranked card); not a separate headword
_drop_reasons.인제: colloquial variant of the much more common 이제
_drop_reasons.정확: stem of 정확하다 'to be accurate'; not used as a standalone noun
_drop_reasons.저작: mostly a bound element in compounds (저작권, 저작물); rarely a standalone learner word
_drop_reasons.성기: anatomical/sexual term (genitalia), not suitable for core deck
_drop_reasons.콘돔: sexual-content item (condom); low teaching value for general deck
_drop_reasons.즐거운: inflected (adnominal) form of 즐겁다, not a dictionary headword
_drop_reasons.위대: not used on its own; the headword is the adjective 위대하다 'to be great'
_drop_reasons.키드: foreign fragment/name-like ('kid', as in Billy the Kid); learners use 아이/키즈
_drop_reasons.앗다: archaic/bound form; learners use 빼앗다 (higher-frequency compound)
_drop_reasons.비숍: religious title / chess piece loanword; low value
